ignored_as_data.text: Chipz ituma ushobora gushora mu bicuruzwa bitandukanye ufite inyungu za buri munsi na gahunda yo gutumira y’inzego 3.
Ibyo watsindiye bijya ako kanya mu mufuka wawe.
Igihe cyo kubikuza: 6:00 AM kugeza 5:00 PM.
Ijambobanga ryawe ry'ubucuruzi ni PIN y'imibare 6 ukoresha wemeza kubikuza n'ibindi bikorwa by'ingenzi.
Ijambobanga ryawe ryo kwinjira rikoreshwa kwinjira mu konti yawe ya Chipz.
Ingano igomba kuba umubare ushobora kugabanywa na 5,000 — urugero 5,000, 10,000, 25,000, 30,000.
Ingano yo kubikuza igomba kuba iri hagati ya 20,000 na 1,000,000.
Injiza amafaranga buri munsi utumira abandi gushora.
Inzira ishize amanga cyane mu Uganda yo kwungura amafaranga yawe
Iyandikishe rimwe ku munsi (bisubirana saa sita z’ijoro) kugira ngo ukomeze urukurikirane rwawe kandi wunguke UGX 500 igihe cyose.
Kubikuza rimwe gusa — iyo bimaze kwishyurwa ushobora gusaba ibikurikira. Kugeza kuri 1 ku munsi.
Kugura ibicuruzwa bikugeza ku mahirwe yo kuzunguza.
Kuzunguza rimwe ku buntu buri munsi, bisubirana saa sita z'ijoro.
Niba amafaranga atakiriwe, nyamuneka vugana na serivisi z'abakiriya kuri TG.
Niba nta kibaye, porogaramu yamaze gushyirwaho — ifungure ku rupapuro rwawe rw’ibanze. Kuri iPhone, koresha Share hanyuma "Add to Home Screen".
Nimero ya telefone igomba gutangira na 0 kandi ibe imibare 10
Nta gahunda irakora. Kanda Byarangiye urebe izarangiye.
Nta kode ikenewe ubu — uri mu bambere binjira.
Nta kuzunguza gusigaye. Ukuzunguza kwawe k'ubuntu gukurikira gutangira saa sita z'ijoro.
Nyamuneka ntugakoreshe konti ya kera wishyura.
Sangiza umurongo wawe, wubake ubutunzi bwawe, unoze ubuzima bwawe.
Tumira inshuti. Winjiza amafaranga igihe baguze igicuruzwa cyabo cya mbere.
Ushobora kubitsa amasaha 24 ku munsi, iminsi 7.
Vugana na serivisi y'abakiriya ku bibazo bya konti yawe.
Yishyire kuri telefone yawe kugira ngo uyigereho vuba, unayifungure uhereye ku rupapuro rwawe rw'ibanze.
